verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents a first-party test mode and a dedicated sandbox environment. They use testnet blockchains and simulated payments, so no real assets move, and a test API key automatically switches the widget to the sandbox. However, the evidence only explicitly covers simulated payments; it does not show sandbox coverage of off-ramp payouts or swaps/conversions, nor documented deterministic test values. Missing for 10: documented sandbox coverage of payouts/off-ramp and conversions/swaps, deterministic test values (e.g. test cards or amounts that trigger specific outcomes), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rehearse everything without real funds — a documented sandbox or testnet mode covering payments, payouts, and conversions with test values that behave deterministically

citations.quote: MoonPay provides a test mode for integration development and testing. Test mode uses testnet blockchains and simulated payments. No real assets are transferred.
MoonPay provides a dedicated sandbox environment designed for integration development and testing.
Using your test API key with this widget URL will automatically switch the environment to our sandbox.
